prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Kingsbarrow: an old royal barrow and timber mead hall on a shadowed moor among crags. A noble but weathered melody with low strings and hand drum. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
